evidence: Conditional economic scenarios using physical screens, assumed future prices, sector value added and asset lives. Numerical identities are checked; no market equilibrium, validated capacity or probability bounds are established.
reading_rule: U is one common transferable real unit. All products are annual. Earth=100 comparisons use the corresponding Earth measure, not a universal denominator. Negative debtor resources indicate infeasible claims; creditor receipts in those cases are not achievable consumption. GWP excludes intermediate inputs already; operations and debt are not deducted twice. Depletion is unpriced in the reference and varied explicitly.

evidence.statement: Sector weights and realised relative value added are explicit assumptions, not fitted estimates or probability bounds. All three worlds use the same mature technology.

constrained.trade_flow_treatment: Interworld power, computing and other purchases belong in a separate flow ledger. Imported intermediate inputs are already deducted in realised GVA; neither their imports nor provider export sales are added to or subtracted from these totals again.

constrained.evidence: Explicit annual accounting and financing sensitivity assumptions, not observed future costs, market-clearing prices or verified repayment capacity.
constrained.numeraire: U: the caller's common-price real unit; all monetary outputs are annual U unless identified as a stock or construction history.

moon.history_status: Legacy liabilities assumed retired; past payments are not reconstructed.
moon.limitations: Construction prices the initial or end-state asset inventory. Renewal and operating expenditure during the build is not added to initial debt. Staged repayment presumes early orbital/source-industry revenues or external sponsors; eight billion lunar residents and mature lunar output do not exist throughout construction. Early operations and deficits must be funded separately. The mature-CFC ramp memo is gross replacement expenditure under an illustrative linear buildout, not automatically extra borrowed capital.

constrained.ordinary_cfc_scope: Normal housing, productive equipment, food systems, ordinary energy hardware, computing, habitat structure and intangibles. Excludes the explicitly listed incremental assets; the construction ordinary-capital rows are not depreciated a second time.
constrained.incremental_cfc_convention: Installed scenario cost divided by assumed life, using unchanged real replacement prices and a maintained mature stock. These lives are sensitivities, not engineering service-life predictions. Environmental establishment is provisionally treated as produced renewable infrastructure; its biological and financial classifications remain unresolved.
constrained.endowment_convention: Initial air and water are a maintained planetary endowment with no automatic cost/lifetime depreciation. The endowment remains in construction finance. Actual losses, repair and catastrophic instability require physical operating or risk scenarios rather than automatic amortization of the entire original import bill.
constrained.natural_depletion_status: Unpriced. Headline net product is conditional on zero local valued depletion; this is not a claim of zero physical extraction or depletion. Extraction outside the three economic territories belongs to its producer territory.
constrained.operations_status: A policy allocation for collective final environmental and safety services. Excludes producer intermediate inputs, commercial power and habitat operating bills, depreciation, replacement investment, debt service and income transfers. This is a chosen allocation, not an engineering estimate of necessary expenditure. Report it separately and also show the optional residual after allocation.
constrained.trade_closure_status: Required net exports equal minus net primary income minus net principal receipts, with no new external borrowing, asset sales, current transfers or other financial flows. Gross domestic absorption is GWP minus required net exports. Gross replacement equals CFC. Subtracting a further depletion reserve gives the NWP-based resource pool; that reserve is an unallocated planning allowance, not an automatically implemented restoration investment. A trade matrix, demand, prices and export capacity are not solved.

construction_renewal_memo.rule: 0.5 times mature CFC times build years, assuming a linear capital buildout; gross replacement spending, not additional debt by default. This is not a modeled build schedule or a claim that the full lunar economy operates early.

Early operations and deficits must be funded separately. The mature-CFC ramp memo is gross replacement expenditure under an illustrative linear buildout, not automatically extra borrowed capital.

array.gap_treatment: Tranches continue amortizing during the occupancy gap.

Early operations and deficits must be funded separately. The mature-CFC ramp memo is gross replacement expenditure under an illustrative linear buildout, not automatically extra borrowed capital.

earth.status: Explicit first-payment sensitivity on an inherited external Earth liability. The array receives interest and principal. This liability is separate from Earth's lending to Moon and array and is not inferred from current Earth debt.

earth.screen_status: Assumed sensitivity thresholds only; no trade matrix, export capacity, demand or price equilibrium has been verified.

staged_retired.ordinary_cfc_scope: Normal housing, productive equipment, food systems, ordinary energy hardware, computing, habitat structure and intangibles. Excludes the explicitly listed incremental assets; the construction ordinary-capital rows are not depreciated a second time.
staged_retired.incremental_cfc_convention: Installed scenario cost divided by assumed life, using unchanged real replacement prices and a maintained mature stock. These lives are sensitivities, not engineering service-life predictions. Environmental establishment is provisionally treated as produced renewable infrastructure; its biological and financial classifications remain unresolved.
staged_retired.endowment_convention: Initial air and water are a maintained planetary endowment with no automatic cost/lifetime depreciation. The endowment remains in construction finance. Actual losses, repair and catastrophic instability require physical operating or risk scenarios rather than automatic amortization of the entire original import bill.
staged_retired.natural_depletion_status: Unpriced. Headline net product is conditional on zero local valued depletion; this is not a claim of zero physical extraction or depletion. Extraction outside the three economic territories belongs to its producer territory.
staged_retired.operations_status: A policy allocation for collective final environmental and safety services. Excludes producer intermediate inputs, commercial power and habitat operating bills, depreciation, replacement investment, debt service and income transfers. This is a chosen allocation, not an engineering estimate of necessary expenditure. Report it separately and also show the optional residual after allocation.
staged_retired.trade_closure_status: Required net exports equal minus net primary income minus net principal receipts, with no new external borrowing, asset sales, current transfers or other financial flows. Gross domestic absorption is GWP minus required net exports. Gross replacement equals CFC. Subtracting a further depletion reserve gives the NWP-based resource pool; that reserve is an unallocated planning allowance, not an automatically implemented restoration investment. A trade matrix, demand, prices and export capacity are not solved.

construction_renewal_memo.rule: 0.5 times mature CFC times build years, assuming a linear capital buildout; gross replacement spending, not additional debt by default. This is not a modeled build schedule or a claim that the full lunar economy operates early.

operating_funding_memo.evidence: Price and funding sensitivities on physical ranges, not necessary expenditure estimates or additive macroeconomic deductions.

prices.evidence: Assumed delivered service prices for a nonadditive funding memorandum; not predictions or additional GDP deductions.

overlap_rules: Hydrogen electricity is a subset of total delivered electricity.
Film replacement is the same service approximated by optical capital depreciation; do not add both.
Producer electricity and nutrient purchases are already intermediate deductions in sector GVA.
The collective-service allocation is a separate policy sensitivity, not the sum of these commercial bills.

limitations: 301K redesign not propagated through every inherited physical requirement.
Construction and production scenario axes are independent, not matched probability percentiles.
Construction-phase renewal and operations are funded separately; no transition production path is solved.
The array sector allocation is bookkeeping; only aggregate array output is a scenario.
No bilateral trade matrix, export demand, institution, hazard insurance or future exchange-rate system is solved.
The optional ownership example transfers 10% of array NWP as assumed profits; no actual profit share or equity valuation is inferred.
